summary: A cursor over a sequence, which may also walk backwards.
description: `next` and `hasNext` are all an implementation has to provide. The rest — `previous`, `hasPrevious`, `index`, `moveTo`, `size`, `toStart`, `toEnd` — is optional, so a forward-only source can satisfy the interface without pretending to do more than it can.
It is the shape a paged reader takes: rows arriving from a service in batches look like one sequence to the code that consumes them.
